message.skyabyss.ch2.beat.cairn: The foot of the cairn is white. A touch to the tongue: salt.
message.skyabyss.ch2.beat.conch: Far off, something like a conch being blown. The seabirds are all flying the same way.
message.skyabyss.ch2.beat.rim: The island out at sea is not where it was yesterday. The rim of its shell stands above the water.
message.skyabyss.ch2.cairn.tall: A tall cairn. The salt line at its foot is the height of the morning tide.
message.skyabyss.ch2.cairn.low: A low cairn. The salt line at its foot is the height of the evening tide.
message.skyabyss.ch2.cargo.shell: At the bottom of the washed-up cargo, a shell that points the way of the tide. A page, too.
message.skyabyss.ch2.cargo.page: Washed-up cargo. Nothing left but dried kelp and a page you have read.
message.skyabyss.ch2.stele: You copied the words on the beach stele into your book.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.none: The shell is silent. No sign of the island out at sea.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.far_from_sea: Too far from the sea. The sound will not reach the water.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.not_now: Not the hour to blow it. Try again a little before the ebb.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.no_spot: The sea here is too shallow. The island cannot come.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.asked: You blew the shell. A long note crossed the water... and the island turned toward you.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.asked_other: %s blew a shell. The island will come to them.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.reading: The island lies %s, %s. About %s min to the next ebb.
message.skyabyss.ch2.conch.reading_low: The island lies %s, %s. The tide is out now.
message.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.begin: The sea draws back farther than ever. A stone road has appeared on the seabed.
message.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.warn: The tide is about to turn. If you are out on the road, hurry.
message.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.return: The tide is back. The road has hidden itself under the water.
message.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.page: On the dais at the end of the road, a page of the tide folk is wedged in the stone.
message.skyabyss.ch2.aftermath: The stele reads: "Under the water, something is pushing from below. Who? From deep below."
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.titan_tide: The tide has returned. Under the water, something is pushing from below.
commands.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.reset: The great ebb record was reset
commands.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.not_none: The great ebb is already under way (or done). Use reset
commands.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.no_sea: No sea nearby where a road can be laid
commands.skyabyss.ch2.ebb.not_active: The great ebb is not under way
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ch2_drift_log.bod:
Wedged at the bottom of the cargo from the sea, a wet, rippled page.

"I note the hour the tide goes out, every day. Morning and evening. Three days running, the same hour. The island keeps its promise."

The letters slant as if written in a hurry. You feel you have seen that slant somewhere.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ch2_beach_stele.b:
Three lines were cut into the stone on the beach.

One: the tide fills in order to leave.
Two: the island comes to those who wait.
Three: if you walk the road the sea gives up, return before the tide does.

Every line is cut at the height of the water.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ch2_ebb_page.body:
A page found at the end of the road, on the night the sea drew far back.

"We on the shell walked the road across the sea to the shore. The road opens for one night only.
It is not the tide that opens it. The island exhales and pushes the sea aside.

Each time it exhales, a little of the seabed shows. Beneath the seabed, something is still there."
quest.skyabyss.ch2.shore_signs.title: Marks on the Shore
quest.skyabyss.ch2.shore_signs.summary: Marks left by people who read the tide are scattered along the beach.
quest.skyabyss.ch2.shore_signs.done: Someone read the tide. And they, too, were waiting for it.
quest.skyabyss.ch2.shore_signs.gather.jo: A cairn, washed-up cargo, a stele. All three seem left by someone who read the tide. Walk the shore and find them.
quest.skyabyss.ch2.ebb_road.title: The Road the Sea Gave Up
quest.skyabyss.ch2.ebb_road.summary: On the night the sea drew far back, a stone road appeared on the seabed.
quest.skyabyss.ch2.ebb_road.done: At the end of the road, you found a page. The sea returned with the dawn.
quest.skyabyss.ch2.ebb_road.walk.journal: The sea has drawn far back. Walk to the end of the road before the tide hides it. The water is only knee-deep.
quest.skyabyss.ch2.ebb_road.walk.walk: Walk the road on the seabed to its end
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch2_ledger: Ah, you came. ...Good timing. Before we talk about the sea, there is something I want you to see.

This ledger. The tide diary the villagers have kept for generations. Here, the recent pages... this hand.
It isn't mine. Whose was it? Somewhere I have...

...It looks like your writing.
A strange thing to say. Forget it. The tide goes out as it always does.
I see. Whenever you like. The ledger will be here.
